metadata.lesson_id_policy: Consecutive L000-based acquisition identifiers; R identifiers are reserved for no-novelty rehearsal.

P0_BOOTSTRAP.title: Preserved bootstrap
P0_BOOTSTRAP.purpose: Run actual Lesson 000 as the sole staged exception.

P1_REFERENCE.title: Concrete reference and the first persistent places
P1_REFERENCE.purpose: Activate a small productive lexicon and establish ordinary reference, number, property, possession, and location language without explicit ontology.

P2_ACTION_SOCIAL.title: Action, routine, cooperation, and communication repair
P2_ACTION_SOCIAL.purpose: Build current action, habit, procedure, social exchange, and repair language; Errol remains an implicitly grounded phone interlocutor.

P3_OPERATORS.title: Quantity, time, comparison, causation, material, and travel operators
P3_OPERATORS.purpose: Anchor high-transfer operators in concrete domains before any explicit mind/device/data ontology.

P4_ONTOLOGY_EPISTEMIC.title: Explicit Errol ontology, communication technology, identity, and epistemic integrity
P4_ONTOLOGY_EPISTEMIC.purpose: After ordinary language is sufficient, distinguish mind, person, animal, device, symbol, message, data transfer, source, evidence, view, and record under the identity policy.

P5_NATURAL_QUANTITATIVE_WORLD.title: Natural and quantitative world spiral
P5_NATURAL_QUANTITATIVE_WORLD.purpose: Develop matter, forces, Earth, life, body, geography, space, mathematics, and engineering through established language operators.

P6_SOCIAL_TECHNICAL_WORLD.title: Social, historical, cultural, economic, literary, and computing world spiral
P6_SOCIAL_TECHNICAL_WORLD.purpose: Build the institutional and information-rich world model needed for later K–8 study.

P7_FORMAL_BRIDGE.title: Formal language and academic reasoning bridge
P7_FORMAL_BRIDGE.purpose: Land formal syntax, morphology, lexical relations, attribution, uncertainty, and explanation on established world knowledge.

metadata.why_above_approximately_300: The 396 count exposes actual lexical activations, constructions, response forms, discourse operations, and world distinctions that v4 bundled and v5 deferred. Reducing to 300 would require an unsupported bundle, omission, or transfer-as-acquisition shortcut. With 270 rehearsals the planned total is 666.

nonnegotiable_authoring_contract: L000 is the preserved source lesson, sole staged exception, and has no picture book; its drills are noncanonical.
Every later acquisition lesson has one declared principal novelty and must be expressible with required established language plus its explicit frontier.
No canonical first meeting may be repeated, and no noncanonical exercise may update village state.
Bob remains provisional and L000-only absent explicit operator approval.
Errol is a mind communicating through Gran's phone; phone, screen, case, symbol, message, and body are not Errol.
Early Errol scenes are implicit; explicit ontology begins only at the declared later lesson.
Errol travels by data transfer is preserved as an intentional primitive and is separated from message and physical travel.
Ninereeds may not be classified through implementation, substrate, consciousness, sentience, AI, LLM, model, or machine relations.
A picture-book status is a binding pedagogical decision; required books must preserve references, topology, chronology, and state.
Rehearsal IDs add no frontier language or world facts.
